events.text:
Objetivo observado

Observação: A suitable reservation was completed and verified: Willow is Confirmed for Quarterly planning Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 for 12 people with projector included, at a $245 all-charges-included total, within the $350 limit, and the same booking appears in My reservations.

Interpretação simulada: The straightforward choose-room, name-meeting, review, and confirm flow let this first-time persona complete a suitable reservation efficiently, with the review and saved-reservations screens providing the verification the charter required.

Limites: The confirmation uses the relative label Tomorrow instead of a specific calendar date, and the site footer states this is a demo venue where reservations are saved only in this browser session. Atlas was not tested beyond its initial card.

Capturas indicadas: #3, #11, #13, #15. A correspondência com a evidência requer revisão humana.
events.interpretation: Relato do modelo; capturas e conclusões exigem revisão humana.

findings.title: Confirmed Willow reservation matches all stated requirements within budget
findings.observation: The confirmation screen shows Willow as Confirmed for Quarterly planning, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, Projector Included, and a $245 all-charges-included total. My reservations then lists the same Confirmed Quarterly planning booking at Willow for 12 people with projector, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, for $245.
findings.expected: A visible confirmed reservation for 12 attendees with a projector, the requested meeting purpose Quarterly planning, and an all-in total at or below $350.
findings.expectedSource: Persona success criteria and saved charter success criteria stated for this journey.
findings.personaComment: This is exactly what I needed — the confirmed reservation matches my people, projector, purpose, time, and budget.
findings.interpretation: The booking path completed without needing a different room or budget workaround, and the saved list corroborated the confirmation screen.
findings.uncertainty: The screens use the relative date Tomorrow rather than a calendar date, and the footer says reservations are saved only in this browser session for this demo venue.

findings.title: All-in pricing and consolidated review made fit and budget easy to verify
findings.observation: The initial room cards showed all-in totals, 12 seats, and projector inclusion, and the Review screen repeated Quarterly planning, seating for 12, projector included, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, and the $245 total before the Confirm reservation action.
findings.expected: Room options and the pre-confirmation review should make capacity, projector inclusion, and all-in cost checkable before committing.
findings.expectedSource: Inferred expectation from the persona's need to verify capacity, projector, and spending limit before booking; supported by visible card and review labels.
findings.personaComment: I could check the price and requirements at a glance and again before confirming, so I did not have to hunt for hidden costs.
findings.interpretation: Presenting the all-in breakdown up front and again at review reduced the need for extra comparison for this time-pressed persona.
findings.uncertainty: Only the Willow path was completed; Atlas was visible as another $280 option but was not booked or reviewed in this journey.

finding.interpretation: The straightforward choose-room, name-meeting, review, and confirm flow let this first-time persona complete a suitable reservation efficiently, with the review and saved-reservations screens providing the verification the charter required.

persona.name: Alex · Executive assistant
persona.label: Alex · Executive assistant
persona.context: You are arranging the team’s quarterly planning meeting between other tasks. Any suitable room within the approved $350 total allowance is acceptable; you want to get the reservation completed efficiently.
persona.mission: Book a room for 12 people with a projector for the available one-hour meeting slot. Enter the meeting purpose Quarterly planning. Keep the complete cost at or below $350.
persona.initialKnowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.knowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.constraints: Total spending must not exceed $350. You need seats for all 12 people and a projector.
persona.skills: Comfortable with ordinary web forms, room descriptions and checking a booking summary.
persona.decision: Choose an appropriate available room and complete the booking efficiently without unnecessary comparisons.
persona.resources: Desktop browser and fictional meeting details; no real payment information.
persona.expectations: A clear, reliable path to a confirmed reservation and accurate final details.
persona.priorities: Meet the requirements and complete the reservation efficiently within the spending allowance.
persona.successCriteria: A visible confirmed reservation for 12 attendees with a projector, the requested meeting purpose and an all-in total within your own budget. Verify the actual confirmation details.
persona.stopCriteria: Stop after a verified suitable reservation, a supported obstacle after reasonable recovery, or inconclusive navigation. Do not book beyond your budget.

limitations: Fresh synthetic persona retest; does not measure real-user impact.

experience.observation: The Gather homepage shows my meeting as Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 for 12 people with projector required, with Atlas at $280 all-in and Willow at $245 all-in, both marked 12 seats and available tomorrow.
experience.reaction: Willow fits my 12 people and projector needs for $245 all-in, well within budget, so I'll go with that.

feedback.summary: All-in totals with 12-seat and projector details on the room cards let me check fit and budget at a glance
feedback.why: The page already shows Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 for 12 people with projector required, and Willow is listed at a $245 all-in total and Atlas at $280, both within my $350 limit.

experience.observation: The Your meeting step for Willow asks for a Meeting name, with a summary showing Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector included, and a $245 total.
experience.reaction: I'll enter Quarterly planning as the meeting name.

experience.observation: The Meeting name field is focused with the placeholder e.g. Quarterly planning visible, and the Willow summary remains $245 for 12 people with projector included.
experience.reaction: The field is focused, so I'll type the meeting purpose now.

experience.observation: The Meeting name field now shows Quarterly planning, and the Willow summary still shows Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector included, and a $245 total.
experience.reaction: Quarterly planning is entered, so I'll review the booking before confirming.

experience.observation: The Review step shows Meeting name Quarterly planning, states the reservation includes a projector and seating for 12, and lists Willow Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 for 12 people with a $245 all-in total.
experience.reaction: Everything checks out — Quarterly planning, 12 seats, projector, and $245 — so I'll confirm it.

feedback.summary: The review screen consolidates purpose, seating, projector, time, and all-in total before confirming, letting me verify every requirement in one place
feedback.why: It shows Quarterly planning, seating for 12, projector included, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, and a $245 all-charges total, which is within my $350 limit.

experience.observation: The confirmation screen shows You've got a room with Willow marked Confirmed for Quarterly planning, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector included, and a $245 all-charges total.
experience.reaction: The confirmation matches what I needed, and I'll check that it appears in my reservations.

charterSnapshot.name: Book a room that fits
charterSnapshot.mission: Explore Gather from the selected persona’s point of view and reserve a room satisfying their meeting requirements and spending limit. Verify the final reservation details. Report uncertainty, lost work and meaningful experience moments as they occur.
charterSnapshot.scope: Commercial landing page through room selection, details, review and confirmed reservation, including reasonable recovery when a choice does not fit.
charterSnapshot.successCriteria: The visible saved reservation matches the persona’s purpose, capacity, projector requirement and all-in budget. Describe any remaining incompleteness precisely.
charterSnapshot.stopCriteria: A verified reservation, an observed obstacle after reasonable recovery, unsafe action or the session limits.
charterSnapshot.startingState: First visit in a new independent browser session, with no prior reservation or product knowledge.
charterSnapshot.goals: Complete one suitable test reservation and verify its details. Do not confuse a successful action with accomplishing the persona’s goal.
charterSnapshot.expectedBehaviorSources: The persona’s explicit meeting requirements, product-visible prices and requirements, and actual recorded confirmation. Preserve factual prices, room capacities and existing successful booking paths when evaluating changes.
charterSnapshot.allowedActions: Use dedicated test data within the environment policy.
